name: Money Market Unsecured Market Statistical Report V 02
definition: The MoneyMarketUnsecuredMarketStatisticalReport message is sent by the reporting agents to the relevant competent authority, to report all relevant unsecured money market transactions.

ReportHeader.name: Report Header
ReportHeader.definition: Provides the elements specific to the report.

UnsecuredMarketReport.name: Unsecured Market Report
UnsecuredMarketReport.definition: Provides the reason why no activity is reported or the required list of transactions for the unsecured market segment.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
